successors.name: Liao dynasty (Great Khitan State)
successors.text: all of Balhae: Cliopatria's Liao shape from 926 contains the whole Balhae outline

successors.name: Dongdan
successors.text: Balhae's land under the Dongdan kingdom (926-936), a Liao dependency

ledger.x: 698: Tae Choyŏng proclaims himself King of Zhen (Jin) near Mount Dongmo.
c.705: Balhae grows from its founding settlement to the Cliopatria 705 outline (Jilin, Hamgyong, North Pyongan).
c.741: Balhae's growth to the Cliopatria 741 outline.
742: the court moves to the Central Capital at Helong.
755: the Upper Capital is founded at Ning'an.
785: the court moves to the Eastern Capital at Hunchun.
794: the court returns to the Upper Capital.
c.825: Balhae absorbs the northern Malgal tribes.
926: the Khitans take Shangjing and end Balhae.

wars.name: Balhae raid on Dengzhou and Tang-Silla counterattack
wars.outcome: Balhae's navy killed the prefect of Dengzhou (732); Mu led troops to Madushan; a Tang-Silla attack was repelled in 733 (Mu page: heavy snow); Silla attacked in vain in 734; Balhae made peace with Tang in 737.

wars.name: Seon's campaigns
wars.outcome: Liaodong and the northern Malgal tribes absorbed; pressure on Silla's border (Silla fortified it in 826).

wars.name: Khitan conquest of Balhae
wars.outcome: Conflict with Liao 'began over Khitan groups near Chifeng and Tongliao' in 907; Silla allied with Balhae in 911, Balhae attacked the Khitans in 924, a Balhae general surrendered to Goryeo and Silla allied with the Khitans in 925; the Khitans took Shangjing in…

certainty.note: No frontier is surveyed or fixed by treaty on the pages: the Mohe, Khitan, Tang and Silla frontiers are approximate throughout.
